tagline.en: LingBot's interactive world model — navigate a scene from a single image with camera control, rendering coherent world video.
tagline.zh: LingBot 的交互式世界模型——从单张图片出发、带相机控制地在场景中导航,渲染连贯的世界视频。

en: LingBot-World, from LingBot, is an interactive world model. Starting from a single image, it generates video of a scene that you can navigate with camera controls.

The released base-cam checkpoint drives camera-controlled world video; a base-act variant covers action-conditioned generation. Weights are partially released. The full-quality camera-control recipe renders a 161-frame clip at 832×464 and 16 FPS.
In WorldFoundry it runs as image-navigation-video and image-action-video tasks. It supports both single-GPU and multi-GPU topologies through the Studio/API route, resolving from local checkpoints.
zh: LingBot-World 由 LingBot 开发,是一个交互式世界模型。从单张图片出发,它生成可用相机控制导航的场景视频。
已发布的 base-cam checkpoint 驱动相机控制的世界视频;base-act 变体覆盖动作条件生成。权重为部分发布。全质量相机控制配方可渲染 161 帧、832×464、16 FPS 的片段。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以图像导航视频与图像动作视频任务运行。通过 Studio/API 路径,它同时支持单卡与多卡拓扑,并从本地 checkpoint 解析。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to navigate an image-conditioned world with camera control and render a coherent multi-second clip; an action-conditioned variant is available too.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想以相机控制在图像条件的世界中导航、并渲染出连贯的数秒片段时,使用它;它还提供动作条件的变体。

notFor.en: Weights are only partially released, and full-quality runs target a multi-GPU setup, so it is not a lightweight or fully-open option.
notFor.zh: 权重仅为部分发布,且全质量运行面向多卡配置,并非轻量或完全开放的方案。

en: Interactive world model with camera control from a single image
Runs on both single-GPU and multi-GPU topologies
zh: 从单张图片进行带相机控制的交互式世界建模
相机(base-cam)与动作(base-act)条件的两种变体
同时支持单卡与多卡拓扑运行
